name: Listing Title Length Constraint
description: Verifies that the listing title is between 10 and 60 characters in length.

name: Price Format Validation
description: Ensures the price field is a valid positive number formatted with exactly two decimal places (e.g., 19.99).

name: Image Count Minimum
description: Confirms that the listing contains at least 3 distinct image URLs.

name: Description Keyword Density
description: Checks that the description contains at least 5 unique keywords from the provided category-specific keyword list.

name: Shipping Policy Presence
description: Validates that a non-empty shipping policy string is provided and contains the word 'free' or 'shipping'.
